blurb: The Jamaica Pond Boat House rents sailboats, rowboats, and kayaks. It is administered by the Massachusetts Division of Fisheries and Wildlife. The Boathouse is open from Patriot's Day weekend through Halloween, with varying hours depending on the day of the week.
extraNote: Park closes at 11:30 pm · No swimming or wading allowed · No alcoholic beverages allowed · Dogs must be on a leash and cleaned up after · Patriot's Day weekend through Halloween
